name: Can you repair subfloor damage as part of flooring repair?

mainEntity.name: Can you repair subfloor damage as part of flooring repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, addressing subfloor damage is often an integral part of comprehensive flooring repair, particularly if the subfloor's integrity is compromised. Issues like water damage, rot, unevenness, or squeaks originating from the subfloor must be resolved before new flooring or repairs can be successfully completed. We inspect the subfloor during our assessment and recommend necessary repairs, which might include patching, reinforcement, or replacing sections of the subfloor to ensure a stable and durable foundation for your finished floor.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, we can repair subfloor damage, which is crucial for a stable floor. This may include patching, reinforcement, or replacement.
